extracted_content.title: Overview
extracted_content.content: According to the American Medical Association (AMA) Coding with Modifiers publication, "A physician may elect to terminate a surgical or diagnostic procedure due to extenuating circumstances or those that threaten the well-being of the patient. The discontinued procedure may be reported by adding modifier 53 to the code. Modifier 53 is only used for professional services." This policy outlines Humana's billing requirements and reimbursement for services reported with modifier 53.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana requires a provider to report modifier 53 if the procedure is discontinued after anesthesia is administered. Modifier 53 should not be used for:

Charges for laparoscopic and endoscopic procedures converted to open procedures Humana will reject or deny a charge if modifier 53 is submitted inappropriately.

If modifier 53 is appropriately appended to a service code, a Humana Medicare Advantage (MA) plan allows 29 percent of the provider's contracted rate. In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply.

If modifier 53 is appropriately appended to a service code and that code has a modifier 53-specific rate in the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS), a Humana MA plan allows the rate stated in the MPFS. If modifier 53 is appropriately appended to a service code and that code does not have a modifier 53-specific rate in the MPFS, a Humana MA plan allows the service code's base maximum amount payable under the member's plan, multiplied by the percentage of the service that was completed. For example, if 15 percent of the procedure was performed, then the plan allows 15 percent of the base maximum amount payable under the member's plan for the service code. Humana requires a provider to submit medical records, including the operative report. In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply.

In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana requires a provider to report modifier 53 if the procedure is discontinued after anesthesia is administered. Modifier 53 should not be used for:

Charges for laparoscopic and endoscopic procedures converted to open procedures Humana will reject or deny a charge if modifier 53 is submitted inappropriately. If modifier 53 is appropriately appended to a service code, Humana allows:

29 percent of the provider's contracted rate; or

29 percent of the base maximum amount payable under the member's plan, if the provider is not contracted.

Note: In certain circumstances, additional payment rules may apply. For example, when applicable, claims are subject to the Humana Healthy Horizons in Kentucky out-of-network payment policy. For more information, see the relevant guidance in the References section of this policy.

In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Except when a state-specific Medicaid section is outlined in this policy, Humana Medicaid plans follow state Medicaid guidelines, as applicable, regarding the reimbursement of a service code reported with modifier 53.

Base maximum amount payable under the member's plan: The maximum amount of reimbursement for a covered expense, determined by the member's plan. Depending on the plan, this may be the maximum allowable fee, the appropriate Medicare fee schedule rate or an amount derived from another payment model. Actual plan reimbursement may be less than this base maximum amount, because of applicable adjustments.

Modifier 53: Discontinued procedure.
